fol.notes: The factorization is one belief (its least prime and its factors); it gives way (top-level gives_up, as in the DL file). below_spf is instantiated for the primes below 10; the comparison p < smallest_prime_factor(1001) is the arithmetic part.

spf_def.says: The smallest prime factor of a whole number is the smallest prime in its prime factorization.

below_spf.says: A whole number is not divisible by any prime smaller than its smallest prime factor.

seventy_seven.says: 77 = 7 × 11, so 77 divides a number exactly when 7 and 11 both do.
